headline.en: Reuse explicit decisions for repeated agent actions
headline.zh: 为重复 Agent 操作复用明确决策

sub.en: RiskShape normalizes a tool call into an action shape, looks up recorded safe/unsafe labels in SQLite, and returns auto_approve or escalate according to its configured threshold.
sub.zh: RiskShape 将工具调用归一化为操作形状，查询 SQLite 中的 safe/unsafe 标签，再按配置阈值返回 auto_approve 或 escalate。

body.en: The grade reports safe/unsafe counts and the reason for its decision.
body.zh: 评分列出 safe/unsafe 次数及决策原因。

body.en: A high label ratio alone does not approve a shape before min_samples is reached.
body.zh: 达到 min_samples 前，仅有较高标签比例不会自动批准。

body.en: Recognized destructive, privileged-shell and pipe-to-shell scopes always escalate.
body.zh: 识别出的破坏性、特权 Shell 和管道转 Shell 范围始终升级确认。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The script uses a fresh temporary SQLite ledger, fixed tau/min_samples and explicitly synthetic labels. It grades make build and sudo make build as strings without running them or installing a hook.
note.zh: 脚本使用新的临时 SQLite 账本、固定 tau/min_samples 和明确的合成标签。只把 make build、sudo make build 当作字符串评分，不运行命令或安装 Hook。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Isolated SQLite ledger with explicit synthetic outcome labels and production grading; no actions executed or hooks installed.

body.en: The script uses a fresh temporary SQLite ledger, fixed tau/min_samples and explicitly synthetic labels. It grades make build and sudo make build as strings without running them or installing a hook.
body.zh: 脚本使用新的临时 SQLite 账本、固定 tau/min_samples 和明确的合成标签。只把 make build、sudo make build 当作字符串评分，不运行命令或安装 Hook。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/riskshape.git
cd riskshape
uv venv --python 3.12
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .

limitations.en: Matching is based on normalized shape, not semantic equivalence or the current filesystem state.
limitations.zh: 匹配基于归一化形状，不代表语义等价或当前文件系统状态。

limitations.en: Capability detection is heuristic. The privileged-scope rule applies to recognized shapes, not every possible dangerous command.
limitations.zh: 能力检测使用启发式规则；特权规则针对识别出的形状，不能覆盖所有危险命令。

limitations.en: Synthetic label replay does not establish production safety, approval accuracy or compliance certification.
limitations.zh: 合成标签回放不能证明生产安全、批准准确性或合规认证。

body.en: Repeated permission prompts lose context when each decision starts from scratch. A local ledger makes prior labels visible, but only for the same normalized action shape; new or insufficiently labeled shapes still ask for review.
body.zh: 如果每次权限决策都从头开始，重复提示就无法利用历史上下文。本地账本让此前标签可见，但只用于同一归一化操作形状；新形状和标签不足的形状仍需审阅。

body.en: shape.py derives a stable signature and capability scope from tool name and input. Ledger records labels and aggregates counts. Grader checks recognized privileged scopes, whether the shape has been seen, sample count and the safe-label fraction. Hook and MCP interfaces reuse that grader rather than maintaining separate rules.
body.zh: shape.py 根据工具名和输入生成稳定签名与能力范围。Ledger 记录标签并汇总次数，Grader 依次检查已识别特权范围、是否见过、样本数量和 safe 标签比例。Hook 和 MCP 接口复用此评分器，不维护另一套规则。

title.en: Normalize once, grade from an explicit ledger
title.zh: 统一归一化，依据显式账本决策

body.en: shape.py derives a stable signature and capability scope from tool name and input. Ledger records labels and aggregates counts. Grader checks recognized privileged scopes, whether the shape has been seen, sample count and the safe-label fraction. Hook and MCP interfaces reuse that grader rather than maintaining separate rules.
body.zh: shape.py 根据工具名和输入生成稳定签名与能力范围。Ledger 记录标签并汇总次数，Grader 依次检查已识别特权范围、是否见过、样本数量和 safe 标签比例。Hook 和 MCP 接口复用此评分器，不维护另一套规则。

alt.en: Normalize once, grade from an explicit ledger
alt.zh: 统一归一化，依据显式账本决策

body.en: RiskShape recommends or emits a permission decision where a caller integrates it. It does not execute commands, prove they are safe, or install a sandbox. The safe-label fraction is an empirical property of the ledger, not a calibrated probability of future harm.
body.zh: RiskShape 在调用方接入的位置建议或输出权限决策，不执行命令、不证明命令安全，也不安装沙箱。safe 标签比例是账本经验统计，不是未来风险的校准概率。

body.en: RISKSHAPE_DB selects the SQLite path (default ~/.riskshape/ledger.db). RISKSHAPE_TAU defaults to 0.85 and RISKSHAPE_MIN_SAMPLES to 3. The decision requires enough labels and a safe fraction at or above tau, while recognized privileged scopes always escalate. init seeds default shapes; treat these as supplied labels rather than observations of your own commands.
body.zh: RISKSHAPE_DB 指定 SQLite 路径，默认 ~/.riskshape/ledger.db。RISKSHAPE_TAU 默认 0.85，RISKSHAPE_MIN_SAMPLES 默认 3。自动决策要求足够标签且 safe 比例达到 tau，已识别特权范围始终升级确认。init 会加入默认形状种子，应将其视为提供的标签，而非对个人命令的实际观察。

body.en: grade explains one normalized shape; ledger lists labels and decisions. record --tool Bash "make build" safe adds an operator label to the selected database. converge replays its corpus in an isolated database; its default corpus is synthetic. hook-snippet prints integration configuration for inspection. riskshape mcp serve exposes the local MCP interface.
body.zh: grade 解释一个归一化形状，ledger 列出标签和决策。record --tool Bash "make build" safe 向所选数据库添加操作员标签。converge 在隔离数据库中回放语料，默认语料为合成数据。hook-snippet 打印供检查的接入配置，riskshape mcp serve 提供本地 MCP 接口。

details.code:
.venv/bin/riskshape grade --tool Bash "make build"
.venv/bin/riskshape ledger
.venv/bin/riskshape converge --json
.venv/bin/riskshape hook-snippet
